description: Approvals of ART a human gave outside the studio's own review form (in chat), recorded here by an agent, tied to the exact bytes approved. The Review tab reads this file and never writes it; the git-ignored local revision store is NOT the record. An agent only transcribes what the human said; it never approves. This file is a record, not a gate: a frame whose sha256 differs from the one recorded here is NOT covered and is shown as changed since approval. `frames` maps a frame key (longtime/<asset>/<frame>) to the sha256 of its PNG under assets/processed_longtime; `raw_files` maps each tracked raw PNG of a character to its sha256. An asset entry may carry `shared_dir: true` when its frame_dir holds the frames of several assets (a flat directory of <assetId>_<n>.png files). The per-asset provenance.json files of the Longtime characters point here (review.approval_id); the six Longtime effects' provenance.json files keep the older 'review pending' wording, which predates their approval. This file is the record of the review.
